data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

Apr 21, 2023

## [Customer Communication Sucks](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6442b45a746ca7dfea0e03d0)
The customer communication from LuLu and Georgia is TERRIBLE. I received notification that my order shipped on 4/18. The tracking link does not work within the email I received. When I reached out to customer service, they said 'well that's because you are white glove'. White glove means I should be receiving EXTRA attention, not having to contact customer service to see where my order is. It is 4/21 and I still haven't received any notification from the delivery company regarding an update on my order. As someone who previously worked in supply chain for a major retailer, I feel you are failing your customers by not having transparent customer communication processes. It's hard for me to justify paying $199 for white glove service in the future, knowing that I will be in the dark for the remainder of my customer journey.

March 22, 2023

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Apr 21, 2023

Hello, we are sorry for the error on the tracking sent earlier this week, we do see you connected with a customer experience agent this week on the status of your order and our delivery partner was in contact with you today to schedule your delivery. Please let us know if we can be of any further assistance at support@luluandgeorgia.com, we are happy to assist.
